name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

statusLabels.description:
The list of {@link MlModel.Route.Status.Label}s that should be used for running model inference. If
not specified, model inference will be run for the `CHAMPION` models by default. This field will override the
{@link Filter} spcified in {@link #mlOperationJobSpec}.

overrideInferencePeriodForInference.description:
Flag to indicate if the inference period provided should be overriden to account for
incremental inference.

This flag is used in {@link ReliabilityAsset#beforeRunReliabilityRiskModelInference}.

workflowType.description:
With `SEQUENTIAL`, the {@link Workflow} looks like the following:
```
| MlSubject.ProcessJob |
           |
           v
| MlSubject.InterpretJob |
           |
            -------------
                        |
                        v
| RefreshNormalizationBatchJob for predictions |
                        |
                        v
| RefreshNormalizationBatchJob for contributions |
                        |
                        v
| MapReduce to distribute ReliabilityAsset#processRiskAlerts |
                        |
              ----------
              |
              v
| RefreshCalcFieldsBatchJob |
```

With `PARALLEL`, the {@link Workflow} looks like the following:
```
                                ASSETS
                                  |
   ---------------------------------------------------..........----
   |                                  |               ..........   |
   v                                  v               ..........   v
ASSET #1                        ASSET #2           ..........   ASSET #N
1. generate predictions         1. generate predictions         1. generate predictions
2. generate contributions       2. generate contributions       2. generate contributions
3. normalize predictions        3. normalize predictions        3. normalize predictions
4. normalize contributions      4. normalize contributions      4. normalize contributions
5. generate alerts              5. generate alerts              5. generate alerts
6. refresh calc fields          6. refresh calc fields          6. refresh calc fields
```

title:
An interface for creating a {@link Workflow} that starts the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel} inference
routine for all `CHAMPION` models. The steps for model inference are:
1. Generating predictions
2. Generating contributions
3. Normalizing the predictions, i.e., {@link ReliabilityRiskScoreMlPredictionHeader#refreshNormalization}
4. Normalizing the contributions, i.e., {@link ReliabilityRiskScoreMlContributionHeader#refreshNormalization}
5. Generating alerts
6. Refreshing relevant stored calculated fields, i.e., {@link ReliabilityAsset#refreshCalcFields}

There are two ways this {@link Workflow} can be executed:
1. `SEQUENTIAL`
  - All the steps mentioned above are executed sequentially, i.e., predictions will be generated for all assets before moving on to generating contributions for all assets, and so on
2. `PARALLEL`
  - All the steps are executed sequentially per-asset, i.e., for one asset all the steps are performed sequentially and the distributed nature of the job applies to the assets. In this case, the inference routine for one asset may complete before another asset (due to, for example, differences in size of data)
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.ModelInference
